evidence.ACL: The contour of ACL is not all in a straight line and increase signal intensity inside, in favor of grade 2 injury.
evidence.MCL: Increased singal intensity surround the medial collateral ligament with suspicous of some laxity fiber, R/O grade 1-2 injury.
evidence.Medial Meniscus: Increased signal intensity of meniscus root of medial meniscus, R/O meniscus injury.
evidence.Synovitis: hypertrophy of the synovium, indicative of synovitis.
evidence.Contusion: Abnormal signal intensity is noted in proximal tibia and distal femur and fibular head, which shows low signal intensity on T1WI and high signal intensity on T2WI, in favor of bone contusion
